Kennel cleaning explained after departure
This article covers the basics for everyone using the desk
Kennel cleaning after travel

Sorry for the hassle, but kennel cleaning matters once your animal has left the cabin or hold area. The Companion Animal Travel Desk asks travelers to tidy the kennel right away so the next trip starts clean and safe. A quick wipe, a check for spills, and a careful look at fasteners usually does the trick.

If you traveled with a bird, <<FACT F077>>. Please follow the travel notes that come with the booking, since the safety coordinator checks for wear, loose parts, and anything that could cause a problem on the next route. If the carrier looks damaged, do not reuse it until it is fixed or replaced.

For cat travel, <<FACT F055>>. The passenger coordinator can point out which forms, labels, and kennel details need attention before the next trip. If you used bedding, food bowls, or absorbent pads, remove them and pack them out with your other waste so the kennel stays ready for the next passenger animal.

A little care goes a long way, and it helps Aurelia Skyways keep things orderly for everyone. If you are unsure about a cleaning step, bring the kennel details to the Companion Animal Travel Desk and we will walk through the next steps with you.
